definitions.explanation: Something that changes every day, most commonly used for daily lunch specials or rotating menus at restaurants.

examples.japanese: {日替|ひが}わり⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered the daily lunch special.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{定食屋|ていしょくや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日替|ひが}わり⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: This set-meal restaurant has a variety of daily specials, so I never get bored.

notes:
{日替|ひが}わり is most commonly seen in restaurant contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日替|ひが}わり⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧ (daily lunch special)
- {日替|ひが}わり⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧ (daily changing menu)
- {日替|ひが}わり⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧ (daily set meal)
- {日替|ひが}わり⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (daily bento)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{週替|しゅうが}わり→週替わり：09824_shuugawari⟧: weekly special
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: today's (special)
- ⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧: recommendation

WRITING:
- Can also be written as {日|ひ}{替|がわ}り with okurigana.
